content.body: The Bf109F was an improved model over the 109E. It boasted a higher climb rate and top speed, in addition to the new MG151 high velocity electrically fired 20mm cannon. However its weight increased as well ... hurting its turn performance over that which could be extracted from the lighter more nimble 109E.
content.brief: TYPE: Fighter Interceptor CREW: 1 ARMAMENT: 1 x 20mm MG.151 Cannon 2 x 7.92mm LMG WEIGHT: 2811 kg MAX SPEED: 627 km/h
